items.consequence: If a client-supplied `x-vercel-isr` header reaches the serverless function, a request to `/api/public?x_astro_path=/api/private` can select the private route simply by setting that header to `1`. This also affects `_render` deployments without ISR and defeats the existing protection against untrusted path overrides, potentially bypassing Vercel route-specific protections. The ISR override needs a trusted signal rather than a request header that a client can supply.
